name: REJAL
entity: 05-SSE distributed by SuamiSihat Ecommerce Sdn Bhd (live site footer also lists REJAL HERBSS ENTERPRISE LA0088749-P)
product_facts: Wild Tualang honey (Apis dorsata), bawang lanang (pearl garlic) in Tualang honey, stevia
Live-site products & prices (rejal.co): Bawang Lanang + Madu Tualang 35g (RM 20.00 / reg RM 30.00), Bawang Lanang + Madu Tualang 250g (RM 80.00 / reg RM 100.00), Rejal Madu Tualang (RM 150.00)
Former name 'Rijal' is retired; do not use
Honey and bawang lanang declared by weight (g/kg); jar capacity is internal
color_rules: No green (implies 'organic'; green belongs to Dr. MIT Ring)
Heritage Gold is a finish only (gold caps, QUALITY SEAL band); never flat yellow, never a UI fill
White wordmark on Rejal Black; black wordmark on white
Rejal Blue emblem/ribbon labels are large text only

fonts.display: Bold condensed caps for wordmark and product names (Bebas Neue as digital stand-in); Poppins Medium caps tracked +300 for section labels
fonts.body: Poppins Regular; label text at least 6 pt

rules: Do not use old 'Rijal' spelling or (R) next to REJAL
Never recolour (never green or gold) or stretch the wordmark
Do not place the emblem on white
No AI-rendered packaging; no claims next to the logo
Clear space half letter height; wordmark min 18 mm / 72 px

graphic_device: REJAL repeat texture, dark grey #3A3536 on Rejal Black only; never behind the main wordmark or emblem
photography: Real product, warm low-key light, dark stone or aged wood, raw ingredients in shot. Cut-outs on white for marketplaces. No AI renders.
voice: Dignified and warm, like a family recipe passed on
Plain-spoken: ingredients, origin, how to enjoy it
avoid: Medical or sexual-health language (ubat, melancarkan darah, tenaga batin, kuat)
Lab numbers or percentages without a report on file
doctor_allowed_in_ads: avoid medical framing; ask brand owner
source: SuamiSihat Design System repo (static/products/<slug>/metadata.json, docs/claims-review/README.md and audit-2026-10-13.md), brand guideline v1.0 PDFs (16 Oct 2026), and live site https://rejal.co/
staff_claims_review: Never publish: 'melancarkan darah', 'tenaga batin', immunity, cardiovascular, digestive or nitric-oxide benefits, 'organic', lab values (TPC, diastase, SAC %)
Describe ingredients, origin and use only
Labels need kcal/kJ nutrition, real serving size, net weight, infant warning on honey; Halal/MeSTI only from the manufacturer's own valid certificate

Caution on live-site copy (rejal.co): do not copy website phrases such as 'Natural Immune Defense', 'Healthy Blood Flow', 'Cardiometabolic Support', 'Melancarkan Penghadaman' or 'madu organik' into video ads.

angles: Origin of the Tualang honey and bawang lanang
not_allowed: Testosterone, energy, stamina, immunity, blood-flow or sexual-health claims
bawang_lanang_madu_tualang.note: Faceless / b-roll style fits best: real product, warm low-key light, dark stone or aged wood.

angles: Wild Tualang honey harvested from tropical rainforest Tualang trees (Apis dorsata)
Raw, unheated honey flavour and aroma profile
Daily spoonful routine (1-2 teaspoons morning or night)
not_allowed: Immunity, infection, cough/throat treatment, digestive or stamina claims
Doctor endorsement (MMC 5.14) or green colour cues
